summary: Trauma symptoms (bad dreams, avoidance) without danger
messages: I keep having bad dreams about that day and I avoid going near the market.

messages.text: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Had bad dreams about it, or thought about it when you did not want to?
In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Tried hard not to think about it, or stayed away from things that remind you of it?
In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt constantly on guard, watchful or easily startled?
In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt numb or cut off from people, activities or your surroundings?
In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt guilty, or unable to stop blaming yourself or others?
